audit.why: Four spike entries present and correctly placed: his Chomp AD-steal window Lvl 3-5, Subjugate at 6, your first-item damage race, and the late crit window. audit.whatIsWrong: Pillar of Ice is described only as a slow ('Pillar slow', 'slows you for a long chase'). Its decisive property against Yasuo is that it is impassable terrain, and the Don'ts entry titled 'Get pillar-kited' carries an unrelated boilerplate description about burning a cooldown.
audit.why: Riot's text: Pillar of Ice 'creates an ice pillar at target location, becoming impassable terrain'. Sweeping Blade (E) is a dash and Steel Tempest (Q) is a dash — terrain denies both, which is how Trundle escapes the knockup setup and how he blocks your escape. It is up every 21/19.5/18/16.5/15s. Wind Wall is correctly described elsewhere as blocking nothing of his: Chomp is a 300-range targeted bite, Frozen Domain and Pillar are ground-placed, Subjugate is a targeted cast — no projectile in the kit. spikes[2].text already says this and is right; leave it.
audit.corrected: State Pillar as terrain that walls your dash, with its 15s low-rank cooldown, in whys[2], mid, and the Don'ts description.

audit.whatIsWrong: The applicable missing-interaction flags anti-heal (King's Tribute passive plus Frozen Domain's increased healing from all sources) and the content layer never names a Grievous Wounds item.
audit.why: Frozen Domain amplifies healing from every source, so extended trades inside it are decided by whether Grievous Wounds is applied.
